sex.evidence: male and female, 5-HT 2A R knockout (KO) and wild type (WT) mice

dosing.evidence: injected with a single noribo dose (10 or 40 mg/kg; i.p.)

group_housing.evidence: Males and females (8-12-week-old) were housed in a light- and temperature-controlled room... with water and food ad libitum (cage density not specified)

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12 h light/dark cycle (lights on at 8:00 a.m.)... Behavioral recordings were made... from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. of the light period of the photocycle

assays.assay_description: Locomotor activity (total distance traveled, cm) recorded in custom-designed open-field boxes (19 x 40 x 40 cm) using a CCD camera and Ethovision XT. 15 min habituation/baseline followed by 30 min recording post-injection of vehicle, noribogaine 10 mg/kg or 40 mg/kg in WT and 5-HT2A KO male and female mice.

application_type.evidence: administered a single intraperitoneal injection of the corresponding treatment

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were placed in open-field boxes for 15 min (recorded as baseline) and later injected with drugs or saline. (Habituation was the baseline recording session itself, not a separate prior exposure.)

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were placed in open-field boxes... Total distance traveled... was quantified (freely moving)

food_restriction.evidence: open-field plastic compartment (19 cm × 40 cm × 40 cm); no food in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: open-field plastic compartment; no water in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: we measured locomotor activity thirty minutes after a single noribo administration

outcomes.summary: Noribogaine 40 mg/kg decreased locomotion in WT male mice compared to vehicle, but did not affect WT females. In KO mice, the 40 mg/kg dose decreased locomotion in females but did not differ from vehicle in males. The 10 mg/kg dose had no effect in either sex/genotype.
outcomes.statistics: Males: treatment F(2,57)=8.7, p<0.001; genotype F(1,57)=0.52, n.s.; interaction F(2,57)=1.5, n.s. Females: treatment F(2,52)=6.42, p<0.001; genotype F(1,52)=0.01, n.s.; interaction F(2,52)=1.74, n.s. Tukey post-hoc p<0.05.
outcomes.evidence: WT male mice injected with Noribo 40 showed decreased locomotion, compared to the vehicle (Tukey post-hoc; p < 0.05)... female KO mice injected with Noribo 40 showed less locomotion compared to vehicle KO (Tukey post-hoc; p < 0.05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Mice locomotor activity (total distance, in cm) was recorded

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total distance traveled (in cm) was quantified for a total of 30 min after injections (single total).

B5_social.evidence: Animals were placed in open-field boxes individually

B6_cognitive.evidence: locomotor activity assay, no learning component

B7_automated_classification.evidence: we used Ethovision XT 11.0 software (position tracking)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Two-way ANOVA on single measure; no multivariate analysis

E1_environment_type.evidence: custom-designed open-field boxes (19 cm × 40 cm × 40 cm)

E3_bedding.evidence: open-field plastic compartment, no bedding mentioned

D1_continuity.evidence: Animals were placed in open-field boxes for 15 min (recorded as baseline) and later injected... recorded for 30 min post-injection (one continuous session same day)

D2_session_duration.evidence: Total distance traveled... was quantified for a total of 30 min after injections; combined with 15 min baseline = 45 min session

D3_recording_days.evidence: single day OFT recording followed by tissue collection

D4_baseline.evidence: Animals were placed in open-field boxes for 15 min (recorded as baseline) and later injected with drugs or saline

D5_followup.evidence: Tissue samples for qPCR were taken immediately after the experiment

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (Open Field Test) was identified; the electrophysiology (patch-clamp) and qPCR work are explicitly excluded by the rubric.
B1 scored 0 (single measure, total distance only) — overriding glm's score of 1 since the rubric maps 1 measure to 0 points.
D1 scored 0 (single session) — the 15 min baseline + 30 min post-injection were one continuous session, not multiple discrete sessions; D4 baseline still applies because pre-drug data was reported.
D2 scored 1 (15–60 min) — 30 min post-injection recording, or 45 min including baseline.
setup_habituation scored 'no' — the 15 min in the apparatus IS the recorded baseline session, not a separate prior habituation without data collection.
